# wallix-bastion_user (Data Source)

Get information on a user resource, including its authentication methods, profile, group
membership, and access restrictions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific user
data "wallix-bastion_user" "john_doe" {
  user_name = "john.doe"
}

# Reuse the looked-up user's profile and language when creating a related user
resource "wallix-bastion_user" "jane_doe" {
  user_name          = "jane.doe"
  email              = "jane.doe@company.com"
  profile            = data.wallix-bastion_user.john_doe.profile
  user_auths         = data.wallix-bastion_user.john_doe.user_auths
  preferred_language = data.wallix-bastion_user.john_doe.preferred_language
}

# Check whether the account is currently disabled
output "john_doe_disabled" {
  value = data.wallix-bastion_user.john_doe.is_disabled
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `user_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `certificate_dn` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `expiration_date` (String)
- `force_change_pwd` (Boolean)
- `groups` (Set of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_source` (String)
- `is_disabled` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `preferred_language` (String)
- `profile` (String)
- `ssh_public_key` (String)
- `user_auths` (Set of String)

## Usage Notes

### `user_name`

The Required lookup key. It must match an existing user exactly; the data source fails with an
error if no user with that name exists.

### `password`

Declared as a `Sensitive` attribute in the schema, but the Bastion API never returns password
values — it is write-only on the resource side. This data source never populates it with the
user's actual password; treat it as always empty and do not rely on it for any purpose.

### Authentication and profile

- **user_auths**: The set of authentication methods enabled for the user (e.g.
  `local_password`, `ssh_key`, `x509_certificate`, `ldap`, `radius`, `saml`)
- **profile**: The profile name assigned to the user, controlling GUI/API permissions
- **certificate_dn**: The Distinguished Name used for X.509 certificate authentication, if
  configured
- **ssh_public_key**: The SSH public key registered for the user, if configured

### Group membership

- **groups**: The set of user groups this user currently belongs to

### Security and account status

- **ip_source**: The IP address/range restriction applied to the user, if any
- **expiration_date**: The account expiration date/time, if configured
- **is_disabled**: Whether the account is currently disabled
- **force_change_pwd**: Whether the user is required to change their password on next login
